app.name: RowCycle

home.title: Welcome to RowCycle
home.intro: Collect cans, clean the coast, recycle — upload a photo, get points, and spend them on medals, trophies and recycled-aluminium goods.

auth.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, with a letter and a digit.

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.body: We sent a verification link to {{ email }}. Open it to confirm your email, then log in.
checkEmail.devHint: Development: the email is printed in the API console.

verify.title: Verify your email
verify.success: Your email is confirmed. You can now submit actions and check out.
verify.failed: This link is invalid or expired.

forgot.title: Forgot your password
forgot.intro: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to set a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for that email, a reset link is on its way. It's valid for 1 hour.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.success: Your password was changed. Log in with the new one.
reset.missingLink: This page needs the link from the reset email.

profile.notVerifiedHint: Open the link we emailed you to submit actions and check out.
profile.noBadges: No badges yet. Approved actions and delivered orders earn them.

new.subtitle: Share a photo of what you did. A moderator checks it, then the points are yours.

submissions.title: Submissions
submissions.subtitle: Check each photo, then approve it (the member gets the points) or reject it with a reason.

settings.dailySubmissionLimitHint: How many photos a member can submit per day (1–50).
